how: Reviewer-recorded on DGX Spark (Linux aarch64) as the dedicated test user zylos-test with a temporary HOME and CODEX_HOME, @openai/codex@0.169.1 in a temporary npm prefix. Logged in with `codex login --with-api-key` using an obviously fake key (Codex only checks it when a request is sent; no message was sent, auth.json removed afterwards). Launched with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox in a private tmux socket, pane 200x50. Each screen is unmodified `tmux capture-pane -p` output; cursorX/cursorY are `display -p '#{cursor_x}'` / `'#{cursor_y}'` read immediately before the capture and re-read unchanged immediately after it.
